column3: prompt  (beats template, docs: ANIM_BEST_PRACTICES_1111 2.1; generated on Tar, TTM 3.0, 4 s, rewrite off)

A huge heavy armoured man stands braced with a shield on his left arm, then takes a crushing blow to the chest, staggers back one step, drops heavily to both knees with his arms hanging, then topples forward onto his chest and lies completely still.
A slender woman stands ready holding a bow in her left hand, then is hit hard in the chest, spins half around, her knees buckle, she falls onto her side, curls slightly and lies perfectly still.
A light, athletic young woman stands balanced, then is struck from the front, her feet slip out from under her, she falls flat onto her back with her arms flung wide and lies perfectly still.
A stocky hunched man stands heavily, then is hit hard, grabs his stomach with both hands, sags to one knee, slumps sideways onto the ground and lies perfectly still.
A small nimble girl stands ready, then is hit and thrown backwards, tumbles once over her shoulder, ends sprawled on her back and lies perfectly still.

A slim woman stands with her hands raised, then is hit hard, her whole body jolts, she stumbles back two steps with her arms trailing, crumples to her knees and falls forward and lies perfectly still.
A lean agile man stands in a ready stance, then is hit in the chest, spins around with the force, drops to one knee, then falls face down and lies perfectly still.
A broad strong fighter stands in a boxing guard, then takes a heavy hit, his guard drops, he sways, drops to both knees and falls forward onto his face and lies perfectly still.
A strong woman stands braced with her right arm forward, then takes a heavy hit, staggers backward three steps, her knees give out and she falls back onto the ground and lies perfectly still.
A huge calm armoured man stands, then slowly lifts his right fist high over his head in a proud triumphant roar, holds it there, then lowers it and stands tall and still.
A slender confident woman stands, then raises her left hand holding a bow high over her head in a triumphant cheer, twirls once on the spot, then ends in a proud still pose with a hand on her hip.
A light athletic young woman stands, then does a joyful spin on one foot, throws both arms up in the air in celebration, and holds a happy pose perfectly still.
A small cheerful girl stands, then jumps up in the air with both fists raised, lands, does a little happy bounce on her toes, and holds a delighted pose perfectly still.
A slim woman stands, then throws both arms wide and spins in a full circle, flicks both hands upward as if releasing sparks, and ends in a graceful still pose.
A lean cocky man stands, then twirls two pistols on his fingers, tosses them up, spins on the spot, and catches them with a flourish, then holds a confident still pose.
A broad strong fighter stands, then pounds his chest twice with both fists and lifts both arms in a powerful flex, then holds a proud still pose.
A strong woman stands, then raises her right arm high in the air and flexes it, then pumps the fist twice and holds a defiant still pose.

A huge heavy armoured man stands braced with a shield on his left arm, then drags a long heavy hammer back low behind him with his right hand, then suddenly swings it forward and up in one big wide crescent arc across his body, his whole body twisting and stepping forward with the swing, then holds perfectly still.

A huge heavy armoured man stands braced, then crouches low and coils, then suddenly leaps forward into the air, raising a long heavy hammer overhead with his right hand, and crashes down onto the ground with a huge two-handed overhead slam, kneeling slightly on impact, then holds perfectly still.

A huge armoured man stands with a shield on his left arm, then swings a long heavy hammer in fast wide circles round his head and shoulders with his right arm at full arm's length, spinning his body with each turn, keeps whirling, then finally whips it down in front of him with a huge swing and holds perfectly still.

A slender woman stands ready with a bow in her left hand, then quickly raises it to the sky and draws back, then snaps her right hand away three times in quick succession releasing arrows high into the air, then holds the bow up perfectly still.

A slender woman stands side-on with a bow held out in her left hand, then draws back her right hand fast to her cheek, holds one breath, then snaps her right hand open releasing the arrow sharply with her bow arm staying locked straight, then holds perfectly still.
A huge heavy armoured man stands braced, then is struck hard in the chest, jerks his upper body backwards, rocks on his feet without moving them, then braces upright again.
A slender woman stands ready, then is struck in the chest, her upper body snaps backward, her arms flinch up, she rocks in place without stepping, then recovers upright.
A broad strong fighter in a boxing guard is hit hard in the face, his head snaps to the side, his shoulders twist, he rocks in place without stepping, and then snaps back into guard.
A small nimble girl stands ready, then is struck in the chest, her upper body snaps back and her arms fly up, she rocks on her toes without stepping, then recovers.
